body: -- Founder: 'we are still failing to refresh our token' / 'also are all of our token calls going through iduna?' Real gap: the Google-sign-in widget stored a 1h token and never called IDUNA's existing POST /api/v1/auth/refresh (S126-08). Added proactive 20min refresh interval + reactive retry-once-on-401 for the nomination submit call. Confirmed all token issuance (auth/google, auth/refresh, agent auth) routes through IDUNA, none minted elsewhere. Commit eb8ce76, deployed.
title: Fixed: auth strip never refreshed its token
